verdict.rationale: Maritime ships ready-made template agents that deploy in one click with no code and use Maritime's metered LLM access by default. You can talk to them and delegate work: scheduling digests that the platform turns into real wake triggers, acting on your behalf through Google, and even migrating workloads from an old provider into Maritime. However, these are agents you deploy and host, not a documented assistant embedded in the product's own dashboard or workbench. missing for 10: a documented in-product assistant or copilot inside the Maritime UI, and hands-on or independent corroboration of delegated task execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Deploy a complete agent from a template and talk to it, in under 5 minutes. No code.
No key is required: the agent uses Maritime's metered LLM access by default.
tell it "send me a digest every weekday at 9" and the platform syncs the schedule it sets for itself into real wake triggers.
point Claude Code or your Maritime agent at a provider's runbook page and it can inventory the old provider with read-only credentials, recreate each workload as a Maritime agent
connect your Google account so it can act on your behalf.
